title: Let an open parent be cancelled or superseded while its open optional children are detached as independent work
outcome: Let an open parent be cancelled or superseded while its open optional children are detached as independent work
acceptance: An open optional child of an open parent can be detached into an independent root, keeping its id, notes and history, without first completing, cancelling or superseding an ancestor
After its open optional children are detached, the parent can be cancelled or superseded with a replacement; required open children still block disposal, as today
A CLI behaviour test drives the observed case end to end: a parent with four open optional children is superseded after they are detached, and each refusal that remains names its route
